fields.Name: IT63 - Agent Wire Callback (fire-and-forget)
fields.Description: The one over-the-wire agent bundle: fire-and-forget RunAIAgent resolves via the WebSocket completion callback with a settled run (WC1), and onProgress fires with at least one streaming progress event (WC2). Exercises the browser/headless-WS follow-up callback path the rest of the family (server-in-process) does not. 2 checks WC1-WC2, live-model.
